verses.text: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
lines: My son, keep my words.
Lay up my commandments within you.

verses.text: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
lines: Keep my commandments and live!
Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

verses.text: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
lines: Bind them on your fingers.
Write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.text: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
lines: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.”
Call understanding your relative,

verses.text: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
lines: that they may keep you from the strange woman,
from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

verses.text: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
lines: For at the window of my house,
I looked out through my lattice.

verses.text: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
lines: I saw among the simple ones.
I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

verses.text: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
lines: passing through the street near her corner,
he went the way to her house,

verses.text: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
lines: in the twilight, in the evening of the day,
in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

verses.text: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
lines: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute,
and with crafty intent.

verses.text: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
lines: She is loud and defiant.
Her feet don’t stay in her house.

verses.text: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
lines: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares,
and lurking at every corner.

verses.text: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
lines: So she caught him, and kissed him.
With an impudent face she said to him:

verses.text: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
lines: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me.
Today I have paid my vows.

verses.text: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
lines: Therefore I came out to meet you,
to diligently seek your face,
and I have found you.

verses.text: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
lines: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry,
with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

verses.text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
lines: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.text: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
lines: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning.
Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

verses.text: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
lines: For my husband isn’t at home.
He has gone on a long journey.

verses.text: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
lines: He has taken a bag of money with him.
He will come home at the full moon.”

verses.text: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
lines: With persuasive words, she led him astray.
With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

verses.text: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
lines: He followed her immediately,
as an ox goes to the slaughter,
as a fool stepping into a noose.

verses.text: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
lines: Until an arrow strikes through his liver,
as a bird hurries to the snare,
and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

verses.text: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
lines: Now therefore, sons, listen to me.
Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

verses.text: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
lines: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways.
Don’t go astray in her paths,

verses.text: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
lines: for she has thrown down many wounded.
Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

verses.text: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
lines: Her house is the way to Sheol,
going down to the rooms of death.
